Advanced Features and Efficiency The new hybrid diesel locomotives ⁤are equipped with⁤ dual power systems, allowing them to switch between different strategies depending on the operating conditions. Compared to conventional diesel locomotives, these new models ⁢offer substantial improvements in productivity and⁤ environmental characteristics.

They ⁢achieve a significant reduction⁤ in ⁣hydrocarbon emissions by approximately 45% and monoxide emissions ⁣by about ⁢73%. This makes them a⁢ crucial component in China’s broader efforts to develop a greener transportation ‍system.

Historically, steam ⁢locomotives ‍dominated the early years, followed ​by diesel locomotives,‍ and more ​recently, electric locomotives have seen rapid development.
